notes.title: Have Bullet Stuffers Update
notes.notes:
Because bullet stuffers, and stuff. What are they? Well you'll find them dropping from normal enemies, they're probably gonna break some things, but oh well.


New Features:
Added new bullet mod Bullet Stuffer. Drop chance from normal robots.

Added new bullet mod Slug Rounds. Drop chance from normal robots.

Added ammo, health and ability bar readouts on the reticle.

Added shooting or reloading while sprinting interrupts sprint.

Added windowed borderless mode.

The dash now breaks breakables in your way.


Changes:
Nerfed the damage and reload times on double barrel and triple barrel shotguns.

Buffed other shotguns slightly.

Changed the holographic sight to restrict vision less and focus more on improved accuracy. While reddot focuses more on recoil control.

Increased the difficulty on level 2 hard mode.

Added outlines to all loot drops to make them more obvious.


Fixes:
Fixed an audio issue with too many miniguns firing at the same time.

Fixed tool tips not scaling right.

Made laser in boss arena slightly easier to see what side it originates from.

Made the loot door for The Vault Keeper more obvious.

Added a ramp to level 5's arena.

Added safety to prevent players from getting to The Hunstman area too early.

Fixed sleep schedule.

notes.title: Look Ma The UI Update Is Here
notes.notes:
UI Update 2.2.0
Well, it took a little longer than a month to get it done, but the UI visual overhaul update is here! All elements of the UI have had some change or improvement, whether a complete visual change, sound effects, or font, it's all fresh.



With the game feeling in better shape, it's time to turn my attention towards getting a demo out, and more new content to the main game. More news on this soon, but if you want to stay more up to date, check out my twitter for weekly posts.



Aside from the UI changes and bug fixes I've included a few other improvements and changes mentioned below.


Changes
Bonus mode has been removed.

After careful thought, I've decided to remove the bonus mode from levels, and merge the extra event into hard mode. You can still get your bonus mode unique reward by beating the optional objective in hardmode. This way you don't have to replay a level as many times to get all the loot.

Added selling slot.

Selling has been improved, you can now drop your items by dragging them out of your inventory, OR sell them easily by dragging them to the "sell" slot.



Added steam rich presence, now your friends can see where you are in the game. Cause it's cool.

Improved game feel for killing enemies to be even better.

Stores now show how many of an item you own, on the buy screen.

Loading screens now wait for you to press a button before going into the level.

Added sound effects to all UI.

Aside from the UI overhaul the game now has better fonts.

UI menus now show which item is selected.

Buffed heavy melee weapons swing speeds.

Redid base laser sight model.


Fixes
Fixed issues with the mission completion screen not showing all rewards right.

Fixed an issue with The Hunstman boss so the player can more easily melee it.

notes.title: Polish/Game Feel Update and Roadmap
notes.notes:
Welcome closed beta testers and interested knights, to the first major patch, and roadmap for Knights In A Different Spacetime. It's been a busy month and I've been focusing on mainly polishing up the game and working heavily on game feel to make combat even more fun.

[previewyoutube=iD8K99M3UpU;full][/previewyoutube]

Update Beta 2.1.0

Achievements

 Added achievements into the game.

All achievements are now active, and most are achievable. Only a few are not yet achievable as the levels they are for are not yet in the game.

Cosmetics And Art
Post steam page launch I decided that the main character and cosmetics could really use an upgrade.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555398/b94c9701170508cfdf7acc12cfc9c036c2c0e687.png

 New main character knight model art.
 Added 5 new cosmetic armor sets.
 Armor sheen and models are now separate so you can choose your favourite combo.
 Added new feather colours: orange, white, and black.
 Added new white cape.
 Added new armor sheens like crimson and more.
 Some armor cloth pieces match feather colour.
 Destroyer armor now unlocks from the achievement.


Game Feel
I took another look at the overall feel of the game, improving feedback given to the player when you shoot, hit, and kill enemies, to make everything feel better.

https://i.imgur.com/wIfH9M6.gif

 Robots have much improved hit animations, effects, and sfx.
 Improved shooting visuals, animations and feel.
 Improved kill effects.
 Redid many gun sounds and silencer sounds.
 Added slow motion on combo kills.
 Added reload animation improvements to remember what stage of the reload you are at. Reloading without firing all bullets in your magazine is also faster.


Polish
I also worked on a few other areas in the game to improve the player experience.

 Applied new subtle shader to improve game look and feel.
 Redid main menu character animations.
 Improved robots movement so they feel less stiff.
 Added new reload animations for underbarrel guns.
 Added new reload animation for the lmg.
 Added new running animation when using big weapons.
 Added falling animation when running.
 Improved oil splatter effects.
 Added barrel glow to big guns after shooting for a bit.
 Improved shop models in hub.


Changes
I took a look at weapon balancing, and also made a few weapons take more attachments, along with a number of quality of life changes.

 Buffed hammer damage and swing speed.
 Nerfed katana damage a bit.
 Buffed lmg.
 Buffed auto trigger firing speed.
 Added drum mag to smg.
 Added auto trigger on revolver.
 Added final swing on melee weapons do more damage.
 Added, bullets do more damage to center mass hits on robots.
 Changed death and loading screen to use "press any key" before continuing.
 Changed laser cannon now won't warmup unless it has ammo ready to go.
 Changed can now scroll through weapons with mouse wheel in any direction.
 Added background noise and button sounds on main menu.
 Changed increased boundary of far range aiming on controller.
 Changed reduced sensitivity of controller aiming strength at close and far range.
 Changed default brightness to 95%.
 Changed hub puzzle to be easier.
 Added can now dash while sprinting.
 Added robots can now hear your footsteps.
 Changed shop roof models and signs.
 Added player hurt sound variants, and reduced chance of hurt sound being spammed.


Fixes
Aside from a number of bug fixes, I heavily optimized cpu performance and bottlenecks so the game should run even better than it already did.

 Heavily optimized cpu usage as well as other performance improvements.
 Improved enemy meshes to be more performant.
 Improved performance on permanent ragdolls.
 Fixed too many resolutions showing up on resolution list.
 Fixed minigun and laser cannon spin up noises continuing to play in menus.
 Fixed some potential errors with huntsman boss that may have caused a crash.
 Fixed an issue with weapons where enemies shot at point blank range could be missed.
 Fixed issue with tunnel boss knocking player out of the map.
 Fixed an objective trigger issue on level 5.
 Fixed an area on level 3 where player could potentially get stuck.
 Fixed collision on huntsman boss ragdoll to not collide with player, to prevent player from getting stuck.
 Fixed prompt when using underbarrel smg that was wrong.
 Fixed an issue where drop ships could shove the player into the ground.
 Fixed visual on multi barrel shotguns only showing one shotgun choke when attached.
 Fixed ability recharge rate being frame rate dependent.



2025 Roadmap
After a lot of time spent polishing and improving the overall look and feel of the game, I wanted to give you all an idea of the plans for patches and new content coming to the game. As well as the hopeful launch window.

Next Big Update Beta 2.2.0 - UI - End of June (hopefully)
The next update will focus primarily on improving the UI. This will include an improvement to some of the systems such as selling (which is getting overhauled) as well as a complete visual overhaul of the UI to unify it and make it feel like a part of the game. Once this update is out, I also plan to bring on more new beta testers.

Content Updates and Release
Currently there are 5 levels and 2 bosses in the game, as well as a few puzzles and hidden things. While the time frame for new content is rough, I'm hoping to get out 2 new levels in the month and a half following the UI update. This update would put the game up to a total of 7 main levels and 2 bosses, as well as an additional two new melee weapons and at least two more new guns.

Following that update in the next 2 to 3 months I'm hoping to add 3 new levels to the game as well as one new final boss fight, along with melee weapons and a few more guns and attachments. This would bring the final count up to a total of 10 levels and 3 bosses, and ready for launch.

And that puts us into the fall. Allowing some float in that, the hopeful release date is mid to late Fall 2025.

So... mark your calendars and spread the word! Lot's of fun things in the coming months and much more content to look forward to.
